summary: Stop a pending navigation/load without pretending already-committed state is rolled back.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.state: does not undo arbitrary renderer side effects already committed

tests.name: stop loading
tests.expected_behavior: requests Chromium to stop pending load
